items.summary: Grok Bot can be configured to use your CLI's in it's computer. It can connect to your locally hosted memory systems, it can connect to and control your agent-fleet across all computers you own via SSH. Grok Bot as the Orchestrator. I had Grok Bot make itself a plugin so any bots I create can automatically use my custom memory system (called Hindsightly) to coordinate any agents for me.
